description: This file defines enums, functions, and constants related to guardrail providers, including legacy and dynamic provider handling, provider mapping, rendering decision functions, and logo mappings.

methods.name: populateGuardrailProviders
methods.description: Populates dynamic guardrail providers from API response, including legacy providers.

methods.name: getGuardrailProviders
methods.description: Returns current guardrail providers, dynamic if available, otherwise legacy.

methods.name: populateGuardrailProviderMap
methods.description: Updates the guardrail provider map with dynamic providers from API response.

methods.name: shouldRenderPIIConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines if PII config settings should be rendered for a given provider.

methods.name: shouldRenderAzureTextModerationConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines if Azure Text Moderation config settings should be rendered for a given provider.

methods.name: shouldRenderContentFilterConfigSettings
methods.description: Determines if Content Filter config settings should be rendered for a given provider.

methods.name: getGuardrailLogoAndName
methods.description: Returns the logo and display name for a given guardrail value.
